nurse.text: Ow at, duck! Welcome to Stoke Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter. They look like they've walked over the Roaches in the fog.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit yourself down. There's tea in a Potteries mug and an oatcake going spare. Don't tell the oatcake shop.
There we are, right as rain. Fired and glazed, as we say round here. Mind how you go, duck.
The Ark's in the corner, duck. Somebody painted roses on the lid. Go on, have a click.
